summary: As of Oct 31, 2022, 78 listed MarTech names totaled ¥279.25B market cap; October average move +3.37%. Top mover Infoway (英飞拓) +52.7%; Saturday (星期六) largest at ¥15.35B. A-share MarTech 55 names: 43 up, avg +9.86%; HK avg −11.65%; US RingCentral Cloud (容联云) +26.25%, Baozun

html:
Unique Research · Insight / Monthly · November 7, 2022

As of Oct 31, 2022, 78 listed MarTech names totaled ¥279.25B market cap; October average move +3.37%. Top mover Infoway (英飞拓) +52.7%; Saturday (星期六) largest at ¥15.35B. A-share MarTech 55 names: 43 up, avg +9.86%; HK avg −11.65%; US RingCentral Cloud (容联云) +26.25%, Baozun −37.26%.

IPOs: Rungo Interactive (润歌互动, 2422.HK) debuted Oct 17 at HK$0.64, +100% day-one; metaverse name Feitian Cloud Motion (飞天云动, 6610.HK) listed same day at HK$2.21 (+2.12%). Private funding: ¥309M across 7 deals; avg ticket ¥44.1M (−23% MoM); marketing-cloud 49% of capital. Notable: Qingyun Tech (清赟) multi-$10M C (Kangjun lead, Changling follow); OTM Pre-A $1M+ (Renzhi / CCV / Gaorong); imBee $5M A (DCM).

— END —
